title: Ben the King
lines: Ben is a king with a red cap.
When the king sings, the dogs run off.
A bug sits on his cap.
The bug sings a long song.
The bug and the king sing well!
The dogs run back to Ben.

questions.ask: What do the dogs do when Ben sings?
questions.listenFor: They run off. It is right there in the story. If your child is not sure, have them go back and find the line with the word dogs in it.

questions.ask: Who helps Ben sing a better song?
questions.listenFor: The bug. Listen for them to connect the bug singing with the dogs coming back at the end.

questions.ask: Do you think Ben is a good king? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason tied to the story, like "yes, because he kept trying" or "no, because his dogs ran away."
